title: Faith for the Unseen Road
hook: Some prayers are answered with a map. Most are answered with a next step.

bible_verse.text: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.

verification.note: Quoted from memory (KJV, public domain in the US). Check it against a reliable KJV edition before setting status to 'verified'.

prayer: Father, I come to you with questions I cannot answer on my own. I want to see the whole road before I walk it, but you ask me to trust you one step at a time.
Teach me a faith that does not depend on how I feel. When the waiting is long, help me remember every time you were faithful before.
Give me courage to do the small, right thing in front of me, even when I cannot see where it leads. I believe you are good, and you are near. In Jesus' name, amen.
closing: What step of faith is God asking you to take today? Write it down, and take it.
description: A prayer for faith when you cannot see what comes next. 🙏 Share it with someone who is waiting on God.
